name: serveros-fleet-ingress
description: ServerOS Fleet — reach an authorized Linux device and its Claude/Codex sessions through the Fleet ingress MCP server. Carries a remote streamable-HTTP MCP binding and the operator Skills that teach an assistant to discover a real device, reuse an idle session before creating one, and accept only evidence it actually read.

com.serveros.fleet-ingress.note: The 1.0.0 manifest schema defines no icon and no inline MCP configuration (additionalProperties: false), so the two icon slots are declared here and shipped as files. The MCP binding is the separate root file the specification fixes for it — `mcp.json` — and the manifest cannot carry one. Whether any client reads this extensions block is UNVERIFIED.
